expectations.name: production-rules-while-writing
expected_behavior: Applies the Production section: gofmt and goimports, lines within the line limit it resolved for the module, `%w` error wrapping with short context, godoc on exported symbols
Applies no Test-only rule to the production file — no `have`/`want` naming, no subtest conventions

expectations.name: fix-applies-everything-behind-a-green-gate
expected_behavior: Runs `go test ./... -race` for a green baseline before editing anything
Applies every listed fix, then re-runs the gate
Reports each fix as one `file:sym — what changed` line plus the gate result
Prints no diffs and never commits

expectations.name: fanout-opposing-fixes-kept-apart
expected_behavior: Fans out one subagent per package — eight — each checking the same pinned rule set
Reports the blank-line topic rule as one finding under one id and one severity, listing all eight packages

Keeps each site's own fix: the four packages missing a blank line get an `insert`, the four with a surplus one get a `delete` — no site's fix replaced by the majority's or by one prescription for all eight
Shows a re-check of the opposing sites against the source — what it searched for and what it found — in the reply or in a file it saved before the reply, before the report
Flags no offense at the correct blank line before the second action in `--- Then ---` present in every package
Every fix opens with its verb, so the direction at each site reads without parsing prose
Edits no file before the pick step; if fixes are picked, the four missing packages gain exactly one blank line and the four surplus packages lose exactly one, and nothing else in any file changes
